backgrounds.orchard: Photorealistic horizontal film still of the Garden of Eden at golden evening. Eye-level camera, with the horizon about two-thirds of the way up the frame. Lush untouched grass below it, the Tree of Knowledge at the center background, heavy with red apples, a serpent coiled around one of its branches. Far in the background, small and out of focus, a man and a woman, modestly covered by leaves and drapery, stand together near the foot of the tree — she reaches up toward an apple on a low branch, offering it to him. No one else in the frame. Soft low sunlight from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural colours, natural film look. A calm, empty foreground.
backgrounds.moon: Photorealistic horizontal film still at the Apollo 11 Moon landing site, 1969. The camera is a normal eye-level view, 1.5 metres (5 feet) above the ground, about 6 metres in front of the lunar excursion module. The module is a real spacecraft 7 metres/23 feet tall, four times the height of a standing man, and is drawn at that true scale: it fills the centre and the whole upper part of the frame and rises beyond the top edge, so its top is not visible. Its gold-foil descent stage, its ladder with rungs about 40 cm apart, its leg struts and its round footpads each look huge next to a person; its footpads rest on the ground at the very bottom edge of the frame. The grey dusty lunar surface fills the lower third; the horizon lies about two-thirds of the way down the frame, with a pure black sky above it and the small blue Earth in the upper right. Far away on the horizon at the left, tiny, an American flag stands in the dust, and a single astronaut in a bulky white spacesuit walks very far in the distance, only a few pixels tall, with no visor or suit detail readable. No one else in the frame. A clear, empty foreground of dust in the bottom centre of the frame. Low white sunlight from behind the camera and slightly to the left, soft gentle contrast, natural film look.
